QuestInfo.name: An Unknown Savior
QuestInfo.0: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, seems to have something on her mind.
QuestInfo.1: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, said that a while back, she wandered a bit further from town than usual to pick some delicious mushrooms, and stumbled upon a giant mushroom monster that put her in grave danger — until a warrior appeared out of nowhere and saved her. She wants to track him down and repay his kindness, but he vanished the moment he'd saved her, and she's had no way of finding him since. She's hoping I can help her find some clue. To find any leads, I should probably start by heading to the place where it all happened. It seems I need to look for the #bGiant Mushroom#k somewhere at #b#m10001005##k in Henesys. I suppose I'll have to take it down? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the Giant Mushroom, #b#o700000##k, that I encountered at #m10001005#, and found #b#t4031122##k, which I brought back to #p207#. Could this be a clue that leads me to that person?

0.0: #h0#, you came to check on me because you're worried too, didn't you...? I know it all... I know everyone in town is worried about me and showing me such kindness... #p204# and Miss #p201# often bring me delicious food, Auntie #p215# does my hair for free, and Uncle #p214# brings me medicine, saying it'll help me feel a little better... cough...
0.1: I'm grateful for everyone's kindness, but sometimes I hate that I'm always the one being helped. Whew... I know I'm sick like this now, but I was healthy when I was little. Then my parents passed away... and little by little, my health just kept getting worse.
0.2: But after eating the #t4031009# you brought me last time, #h0#, I think I've been feeling a bit better. So a little while ago, I went out a bit further than usual to gather some mushrooms for myself. And do you know what happened? A huge, enormous mushroom suddenly appeared right in front of me. Cough...
0.3: The giant mushroom shot up into the sky and came crashing down right in front of me, and I collapsed from the shock — I thought that was the end of me — but then a warrior appeared out of nowhere and, in a flash, took care of the mushroom...! But I passed out right then and there... and when I opened my eyes, I was lying in my bed at home. Cough...
0.4: There's so much I want to know — how I got back home, and who it was that saved me. Oh, that's right...! #h0#, you're the strongest person in #m10001000# after #p221#, so do you think you might be able to find that person for me?

yes.0: Thank you so much! So, where should we start looking? I don't remember anything except that he was a warrior... Actually, why don't we start by looking for that giant mushroom again? For now, that mushroom is the only clue we have.
yes.1: There's a hidden path somewhere near the two big trees to the west of #m10001000#. I think I met the giant mushroom at the end of that path. But that thing seemed incredibly strong, so please be sure you're well prepared. Please, do take care of yourself out there. Cough...

no.0: I see... I suppose I ended up relying on someone else for help again, without even realizing it.

1.0: Oh, you're back safe! Did you find the giant mushroom? What...? You defeated it and found this #b#t4031122##k...! I'm not sure whether this note has anything to do with him, but since we don't have any other clues, did you happen to look at what's written on it? I'm curious what it says.

item.0: Head into the hidden path near the two big trees to the west of #m10001000#, and as you go further in, you'll find someone's mushroom house. Please look for the giant mushroom there.
